title: Toast
lead: Toast is used to display messages in an overlay.

examples.name: Basic
prose: Messages are displayed by calling the show method provided by the component ref. A single message is specified by the Message interface that defines various properties such as severity, summary and detail.

examples.name: Severity
prose: The severity option specifies the type of the message.

examples.name: Position
prose: Location of the messages is customized with the position property.

examples.name: Multiple
prose: Multiple messages are displayed by passing an array to the show method.

examples.name: Sticky
prose: A message will disappear after 3000ms, the default value defined for the life option. To display messages that remain visible and do not hide automatically, set the sticky option to "true".

examples.name: Template
prose: Custom content inside a message is defined with the content option.
